claims.claim: Capability and reliability diverge systematically as task duration grows, so pass@1 on short tasks is structurally blind to long-horizon failure.
The task length frontier model agents complete autonomously at 50% reliability has been doubling roughly every 7 months.
Across 23 LLMs and four agent frameworks, only 15.4% of trials survive the full horizon, and larger models do not reliably outperform smaller ones.
A diagnostic collecting more than 3100 trajectories across four agentic domains characterizes horizon-dependent degradation patterns.
Capacité et fiabilité divergent de façon systématique quand la durée de la tâche augmente, si bien que le pass@1 sur tâches courtes est structurellement aveugle à la défaillance long-horizon.
La longueur de tâche que les agents de modèles de pointe accomplissent en autonomie avec 50 % de fiabilité double environ tous les 7 mois.
Sur 23 LLM et quatre frameworks d'agents, seuls 15,4 % des essais survivent à l'horizon complet, et les modèles plus gros ne surpassent pas de façon fiable les plus petits.
Un diagnostic rassemblant plus de 3100 trajectoires sur quatre domaines agentiques caractérise des schémas de dégradation dépendants de l'horizon.

sources.label: Beyond pass@1: A Reliability Science Framework for Long-Horizon LLM Agents (arXiv:2603.29231)
sources.excerpt: We show these properties diverge systematically as task duration grows, and that pass@1 on short tasks is structurally blind to this divergence.

sources.label: Can LLM Agents Be CFOs? Benchmarking Long-Horizon Resource Allocation in an Uncertain Enterprise Environment (arXiv:2603.23638)
sources.excerpt: Experiments across 23 LLMs and four agent frameworks show that current agents remain far from robust: only 15.4% of trials survive the full horizon, larger models do not reliably outperform smaller ones, and failures cascade across observation, action timing, and capital sizing.

sources.label: The Long-Horizon Task Mirage? Diagnosing Where and Why Agentic Systems Break (arXiv:2604.11978)
sources.excerpt: collecting 3100+ trajectories across four representative agentic domains to study horizon-dependent degradation patterns

sources.label: Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Tasks (METR)
sources.excerpt: The length of tasks (measured by how long they take human professionals) that generalist frontier model agents can complete autonomously with 50% reliability has been doubling approximately every 7 months for the last 6 years.
